# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting L7 Code or L7 Code-operated infrastructure to
[security@ping.gg](mailto:security@ping.gg). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://github.com/lawrence-millard/l7code2.0/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
